propositions: the review-bot container lacks a configured AWS region (no AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, or AWS_PROFILE), causing boto3.client('bedrock-runtime') to raise NoRegionError at provider construction before any model invocation
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, falling through to boto3 ambient resolution which finds no region in the container environment

IMDS is reachable but does NOT supply region discovery (IMDS-based region supply requires botocore defaults_mode=auto, which is not active), so IMDS reachability and region configuration are independent concerns

pydantic-ai catches the boto3 NoRegionError and re-raises it as pydantic_ai.exceptions.UserError, which is not a subclass of rebar's LLMError, so fail-closed handlers do not catch it and the error message names pydantic-ai's kwarg, not rebar's configuration key

the Bedrock cutover has no cross-provider fallback, so a missing region takes the LLM-Review gate down completely rather than degrading gracefully when REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set to bedrock without region configuration
botocore resolves region from AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (and config files) but NOT AWS_REGION alone, contradicting existing docstrings in bedrock_model.py and config.py
